en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 3. My father and all of my scholars narrated to me from Sa’d ibn ‘Abdillāh, from ‘Ali ibn Ismā’īl, from Ḥammād ibn ‘Isā, from Rib’i, from Fuďayl ibn Yasār, who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: What is wrong with you (people)?! Why do you not go to him? – This refers to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Verily four thousand angels cry next to him (and will continue to do so) until the Day of Judgment.
